# Task P2-03: Decision engine v1 — hard rejections and the 0–1000 score

**Phase:** 2 · **Depends on:** P2-00 (contracts) · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
Given a wanted song, its quality profile and a list of `Candidate`s from any source, decide which candidates may be grabbed automatically and in what order — with every rejection and every score component recorded so the interactive search can show *why*. Pure code (no database, no I/O), golden-tested. This is the part of Wondarr that makes or breaks "zero wrong-recording imports".

## Deliverables
Namespace `Wondarr.Core.Decisions`.

1. `src/Wondarr.Core/Decisions/DecisionModels.cs`

   - `public sealed record Rejection(RejectionReason Reason, string Message)` — `Message` is for people: "Version mismatch: candidate is live, the song is not", "Duration 248 s is 121 s off (tolerance 3 s)".

## Rules (MATCHING_ENGINE §6.2–6.3; the golden file is authoritative)
**Normalisation for comparisons:** `TextMatching.Normalize` / `NormalizeArtist` / `Similarity` (existing, `src/Wondarr.Core/Identity/TextMatching.cs`). The song's base title = `VersionFlagParser.Parse(context.SongTitle).BaseTitle` (existing); the candidate's = `Parsed.Title` (already a base title; fall back to the last path segment without extension when null).

**Hard rejections** (each a `Rejection`):
- `Blocklisted` — `IsBlocklisted(candidate.BlocklistKey)`.
- `NotAudio` — `Extension` not in {`mp3, flac, m4a, aac, ogg, oga, opus, wav, aif, aiff, ape, wv, wma, alac`}.
- `FormatNotAllowed` — `!Profile.IsAllowed(candidate.QualityId)`.
- `NotAnUpgrade` — `CurrentFileQualityId` has a value, not `IsManualGrab`, and `!Profile.IsUpgrade(current, candidate.QualityId)`.
- `DurationOutOfTolerance` — both durations known and `|Δ| > tolerance`.
- `VersionMismatch` — `(candidate.Parsed.VersionFlags ^ SongFlags) & VersionFlagNames.HardFlags` ≠ `None` (`Remaster`, `Explicit`, `Clean` are not hard, so they never reject). Path flags do **not** reject (see `pathVersion`).
- `ArtistMismatch` — `MainArtists` non-empty and the artist overlap (below) is 0, **unless** the normalised path contains a compilation marker token (`various`, `va`, `compilation`, `compilations`, `soundtrack`, `ost`).
- `SizeSanity` — `SizeBytes` known and `< 500_000`; or, with a duration `d` (the candidate's when known, else the song's, in seconds) and the quality `q = Qualities[QualityId]`: lossy with `MinBitrate`/`MaxBitrate` known → size `< d × MinBitrate × 125 × 0.7` or `> d × MaxBitrate × 125 × 1.5`; `q.Lossless` → size `< d × 300 × 125` (a "FLAC" smaller than 300 kbps is fake).
- `Locked` — `IsLocked`.
- `IgnoredUser` — `Provider` in `IgnoredUsers`.
- `UserOnCooldown` — `Reputation[Provider].FailuresLast24Hours ≥ 2`.
- `BelowMinimumScore` — `Total < Profile.MinScore` (checked last, only when `MinScore > 0`).

**Score** (all components rounded to `int` with `MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero`):
- `Title` = `Similarity(song base title, candidate title) × 200`.
- `Artist` = max over `MainArtists` of (share of that artist's `NormalizeArtist` tokens that occur among the normalised tokens of the **full remote path**, with `\` and `/` treated as spaces) × 100. (`Daft Punk` in `@@b\Music\Daft Punk\…` → 1.0.)
- `Duration` = both known: `100 × e^(−0.1 × Δs)` (Δ in seconds, as a double), 0 when `|Δ| > tolerance`; unknown → 40.
- `Identity` = `max(0, Title + Artist + Duration − (pathVersion penalty))`, where the penalty is 150 when `candidate.Parsed.PathVersionFlags & HardFlags & ~SongFlags` ≠ `None` (also listed as the adjustment `pathVersion` with −150 for the UI, but **not** counted again in `AdjustmentTotal`).
- `Quality` — let `ci` = the cutoff quality's group index and `i` the candidate's (`Profile.GroupIndexOf`): `i ≥ ci` → 300; `i` unknown → 0; else `300 − 60 × n` where `n` = the number of **allowed** groups with index in `[i, ci)`, floored at 0.
- `Availability` = free slot +80; queue length `q` (null = unknown → 0 points): `40 × max(0, 20 − q) / 20`; upload speed ≥ 1 000 000 B/s +30, ≥ 350 000 +20, ≥ 100 000 +10.
- `SourcePreference` = tier 1 → 100, 2 → 60, 3 → 30.
- Adjustments: `bracketCheck` +15 when `!HasUnexplainedBrackets`; `albumMatch` +20 when `AlbumTitle` and `Parsed.Album` are both set and `Similarity ≥ 0.9`; `trackMatch` +10 when `TrackNo` and `Parsed.TrackNo` are equal; `reputation` = `min(40, 20 × successes) − 40 × failures` when the user has a record (omit when 0); `explicitMismatch` −5 when exactly one of song/candidate has `Explicit`. `AdjustmentTotal` = clamp(sum, −50, +50).
- `Total` = clamp(`Identity + Quality + Availability + SourcePreference + AdjustmentTotal`, 0, 1000); if either duration is unknown, `Total = min(Total, 849)` and `CappedForUnknownDuration = true`.

**Order:** `Total` descending; then for equal totals, lossy (`!Qualities[QualityId].Lossless`) smaller `SizeBytes` first, lossless larger first; then a deterministic 64-bit FNV-1a hash of the UTF-8 `BlocklistKey` ascending (never `string.GetHashCode`, which is randomised per process).
